issues.issue: P1 editor: the transport row ends with a cursor-tool button and then a second control that is cut off by the transcript pane's right edge at x=950, leaving a sliver of its border visible.

P1 cliplist: the language badge (globe plus +1) sits immediately after each project name instead of in its own column, so it floats at a different x on every row and the title column has a ragged right edge.
P1 editor: of the six greyed-out AI Tools rows, only 'Center active speaker' and 'Blur speaker background' carry a Beta pill, so the faint disabled treatment means both unavailable and beta.

P2 cliplist: seven identical cyan AI badges repeat across the More tools strip and a further four sit on the cards above, so the badge marks nothing specific and competes with the Create project block.
P2 editor: in the Details panel every field label (Name, Saved, Ratio, Resolution) and every value is set at the same ~11px, so the panel reads as one flat block with no scannable pair of columns.
P2 cliplist: the size and duration under each project thumbnail (215.4K | 00:03) is muted grey on near-black at roughly 3:1, far below the contrast of the names above it.
P3 cliplist: three bare UUID strings sit above the Tracks heading with no label, container or heading of their own, so the screen opens on what looks like debug output.
P3 editor: unrendered filler markers appear inline in the transcript as literal tilde-and-dot glyphs mid-sentence ('a challenge, ~. depending') on Speaker 1's paragraph.
P3 cliplist: every track row ends in an identical filled Download button plus an overflow dot, so five equal-weight actions line up under a Create button in the same accent.
P4 cliplist: row 02 draws Keep/Maybe/Skip as bordered buttons with a check mark while rows 01 and 03 to 06 render the same three choices as plain grey text, so one control has two looks.
P4 editor: the active style tab draws a 3px black underline about 17px above a separate full-width hairline divider, so the tab does not connect to the panel beneath it and two rules read as one.
P4 cliplist: the collapsed Rejected row uses the same row rhythm, rule and text weight as clip 06 above it and carries no count, while Clips 6 in the header does, so the two lists read as one.
P5 editor: the issue screen offers no primary action at all, no comment composer, no state or status commit button, only property chips in the right rail and a plus in the header.
P5 cliplist: rows such as ENG-139 carry five to six chips (priority, labels, project, due date) at the same 11px weight, so no row has a first thing to read after its title.
P5 editor: property values (Done, Urgent, olivia, Bug, Cycle 6) render as loose 13px lines that only sometimes sit in a chip, so the rail mixes two control treatments for the same kind of field.
P6 cliplist: the Auto headline banner's explanatory paragraph is set in a monospace face across a ~1130px measure, making the only instructional sentence on the screen the hardest text to read.
P6 editor: words in the transcript switch between green and purple with no legend or key on screen, so color alone carries whatever that difference means.
P6 editor: 'Color correction: OFF' sits in the same toolbar row as the ratio, layout and tracker controls but renders as plain 11px text with no icon, no chevron and no button shape.

notes: Only P4 was given an error screen, so empty/error scores for the other five come from their cliplist and editor states alone. P5 is a project and issue tracker rather than a clip tool; it was scored on what its two screens show. P6 cliplist also carries a hand-drawn red arrow over its right rail, treated as an overlay artifact and not scored.
